---
title: "Racial and Ethnic Groups in Recessions Abroad: Canada, the United Kingdom and Israel"
output: html_document
params:
  fetch: true
  explore: true
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Downloads unemployment by racial or ethnic group from the three peer economies that publish it:
#   Canada: Statistics Canada, Labour Force Survey, table 14-10-0373-01 (racialized groups; three-month moving
#           averages, not seasonally adjusted).
#   United Kingdom: Office for National Statistics, Labour Force Survey, dataset A09 (ethnic group; quarterly,
#           not seasonally adjusted).
#   Israel: Central Bureau of Statistics, Labour Force Survey, by population group (Jews and others; Arabs).
# No keys are needed. Writes data/race_abroad.json for the international page (#intl).
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(data.table); library(jsonlite); library(readxl)
options(timeout = 600, HTTPUserAgent = "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) inequalityofrecession.com data update")
root <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), ".."))
out <- file.path(root, "data-source", "race_abroad"); raw <- file.path(out, "raw")
dir.create(raw, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
diag <- function(name, ...) cat(..., file = file.path(out, paste0("diag_", name, ".txt")), sep = "\n", append = TRUE)
for (f in list.files(out, "^diag_", full.names = TRUE)) unlink(f)
try1 <- function(name, expr) tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) { diag(name, paste("ERROR:", conditionMessage(e))); NULL })
```

## Canada

```{r canada}
ca <- try1("ca", {
  zipf <- file.path(tempdir(), "14100373-eng.zip")
  download.file("https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/tbl/csv/14100373-eng.zip", zipf, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  files <- unzip(zipf, exdir = tempdir())
  d <- fread(grep("14100373\\.csv$", files, value = TRUE), encoding = "UTF-8")
  if (params$explore) {
    diag("ca", paste("columns:", paste(names(d), collapse = " | ")), paste("rows:", nrow(d)), paste("dates:", min(d$REF_DATE), "to", max(d$REF_DATE)))
    for (v in setdiff(names(d), c("REF_DATE", "DGUID", "UOM_ID", "SCALAR_ID", "VECTOR", "COORDINATE", "VALUE", "DECIMALS", "TERMINATED", "SYMBOL")))
      diag("ca", paste0("-- ", v, ": ", paste(head(unique(d[[v]]), 60), collapse = " | ")))
  }
  lfc <- grep("characteristic", names(d), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  d <- d[GEO == "Canada" & get(lfc) == "Unemployment rate"]
  fwrite(d[, !c("DGUID", "UOM_ID", "SCALAR_ID", "COORDINATE", "DECIMALS", "TERMINATED", "SYMBOL")], file.path(raw, "ca_unemployment_rate.csv"))
  d
})
```

## United Kingdom

```{r uk}
uk <- try1("uk", {
  base <- "https://www.ons.gov.uk/employmentandlabourmarket/peopleinwork/employmentandemployeetypes/datasets/labourmarketstatusbyethnicgroupa09"
  page <- paste(readLines(base, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
  link <- regmatches(page, regexpr("/file\\?uri=/employmentandlabourmarket/peopleinwork/employmentandemployeetypes/datasets/labourmarketstatusbyethnicgroupa09/current/[A-Za-z0-9_]+\\.xlsx?", page))
  if (!length(link)) stop("no A09 file link on the dataset page")
  ext <- sub(".*\\.", "", link); dest <- file.path(raw, paste0("a09.", ext))
  download.file(paste0("https://www.ons.gov.uk", link), dest, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  diag("uk", paste("file:", link))
  if (params$explore) for (s in excel_sheets(dest)) {
    x <- suppressMessages(read_excel(dest, sheet = s, col_names = FALSE, n_max = 14))
    diag("uk", paste("== sheet:", s, "dims:", paste(dim(suppressMessages(read_excel(dest, sheet = s, col_names = FALSE))), collapse = "x")))
    diag("uk", apply(as.matrix(x[, seq_len(min(14, ncol(x)))]), 1, function(r) paste(ifelse(is.na(r), "", r), collapse = " | ")))
  }
  dest
})
```

## Israel

```{r israel}
cbs <- function(path, q) fromJSON(paste0("https://apis.cbs.gov.il/series/", path, "?", q, "&format=json&download=false&lang=en"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
il <- try1("il", {
  # the full level-5 catalog of the labour-force subject (11), page by page
  all5 <- list()
  for (pg in 1:10) {
    x <- cbs("catalog/level", sprintf("id=5&subject=11&pagesize=1000&page=%d", pg))
    items <- x$catalogs$catalog; if (!length(items)) break
    all5 <- c(all5, items); diag("il", sprintf("level 5, page %d: %d items", pg, length(items)))
    if (length(items) < 1000) break
  }
  write_json(all5, file.path(raw, "cbs_subject11_level5_all.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
  # monthly LFS, old definition (January 2012 to December 2025) and new definition (from January 2025):
  # labour force (4th level 2) and unemployed persons (4th level 5), for all people and for Jews, aged 15 and over
  for (p in c("11,6,1,2,2226", "11,6,1,2,2238", "11,6,1,5,2226", "11,6,1,5,2238", "11,5,1,2,2226", "11,5,1,2,2238", "11,5,1,5,2226", "11,5,1,5,2238")) {
    r <- try1("il", cbs("data/path", paste0("id=", p, "&startPeriod=01-2010&endPeriod=12-2030&pagesize=1000")))
    if (!is.null(r)) write_json(r, file.path(raw, paste0("cbs_data_", gsub(",", "-", p), ".json")), auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
  }
  TRUE
})
```
